SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
Special Branch No. D 3566:
April 20, 1938 Date 30 / 4 / 38

His Excellency the Governor of Japan
- Official Celebration

In connection with the passage of General
Ninomiya from the Bund to the residence of
the Consul General for Japan, 18 Seymour Road, the
following officers will take up the points allotted
to them:

Szechuen and Tsingtao                 D.C. Gelder
Szechuen - Peking Rds.                Insp. 102
Szechuen - Peking Rds                 D.C. Tilton
Nanking - Honan Rds                   D.C.C. 74
Nanking - Nanking Rds                 D.C.I. Duncan
Nanking - Thibet Rds                  D.C. Moore
O'Fall - Mohawk Rds                   D.P.S. McLeod
O'Fall - Carter Rds                   D.C. Little
O'Fall - Neuhart Rds :                D.S. Prokofiev
O'Fall - Seymour Rds: )               D.P.S. Jones
& to residence of   )                 D.S. Tchereminsky
Consul-General      )                 S.J.C. 77

（批：Bomb outrage at Hongkew Park - see S. 3586）

The General's party will consist of four cars:
No.1 conveying the General with an armed military
policeman; No.2 three men with carbines; No.3 Chief
of Staff and No.4 Army Adjutants. These vehicles
will be led by a Municipal Police motor cycle and
followed by a motor car containing foreign members
of the Municipal Police. The General is scheduled
to leave Hongkew Park shortly after 11.30 a.m. and
travel via Szechuen, Nanking and Bubbling Well Roads.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Parade of Japanese Troops on occasion of
H.I.J.M. Birthday on 29th April

One Regiment will be billeted in Japanese School,
North Szechuen Road, and one Regiment in Japanese School,
Range Road.

The following units will participate in the parade
on 29th:

1 Regiment Cavalry
3 Regiments of Infantry
1 Machine Gun Regiment
1 Howitzer Battery
1 Mountain Battery
1 Transport Company (70 Cars)
1 Company Tanks
1 Company Armoured Cars.

The above troops will assemble from Kiangwan and
be in position along Kiangwan Road north of Public
School for Boys at 8.30 a.m. and be inspected by
Major General Shirakawa.

After inspection (Approximately 9 a.m.) troops will
move off as follows:

3 Regiments of Infantry to Hongkew Park by back gate.
Transport Company will move south along Dixwell Road
and follow No. 6 Bus Route.
Remaining units will march south along North
Szechuen Road - Range Road - Chapoo Road - Yalu
Road - Woosung Road - Boone Road - Howard Road -

4月29日天皇陛下诞辰之际日军阅兵式

一个团将驻扎在北四川路的日本学校，另一个团将驻扎在靶子路的日本学校。

以下部队将参加29日的阅兵式：

1个骑兵团
3个步兵团
1个机枪团
1个榴弹炮连
1个山炮连
1个运输连（70辆车）
1个坦克连
1个装甲车连。

上述部队将从江湾集结，并于上午8时30分在公立男校以北的江湾路沿线就位，接受白川少将的检阅。

检阅后（约上午9时），部队将按如下方式行进：

3个步兵团经后门进入虹口公园。
运输连将沿狄思威路向南移动，并跟随6路公共汽车路线。
其余部队将沿北四川路 - 靶子路 - 乍浦路 - 鸭绿江路 - 吴淞路 - 百老汇路 - 霍华德路 - 向南行进

2个团将作为主力跟随新路线行进。
1个团将沿同一路线行进至eward路，然后前往麦克斯韦路 - 百老汇路。海军装甲车将从 **〔此处转录不清〕** 前往北苏州路，并经北四川路返回。

已要求日本平民于上午9时前到达虹口公园，并将沿北四川路延伸段列队观看游行。

将作出以下交通安排：

(1) 上午9时至11时期间，所有电车将在北四川路延伸段、靶子路、北四川路以东及 Housing Yard 停止运行。

pages.en:
Parade of Japanese troops on occasion of
H.I.J.M. Birthday on 29th April

The following units will participate in the
parade on 29th:

1 Regiment Cavalry
3 Regiments of Infantry
1 Machine Gun Regiment
1 Howitzer Battery
1 Mountain Battery
1 Transport Company (70 Cars)
1 Company Tanks
1 Company Armoured Cars.

The above troops will assemble from Kiangwan and
be in position along Kiangwan Road north of Public
School for Boys at 8.30 a.m. and be inspected by
Major General Shirakawa.

After inspection (Approximately 9.30 a.m.)
troops will move off as follows:

3 Regiments of Infantry to Hongkew Park by back gate
Transport Company will move south along Dixwell Road
and follow No.6 Bus Route.

Remaining units will march south along North Szechuen
Road - Range Road - Chapoo Road - Yalu Road -
Woosung Road - Boone Road - Seward Road -
Muirhead Road - Broadway to Kung Dah Mill.

After an inspection in Hongkew Park the 3
infantry Regiments will march off at approximately 11 a.m.
2 Regiments will follow the same route as the main body.
1 Regiment will follow the same route to Seward Road, then
to Dixwell Road - Broadway. Naval armoured cars will
proceed from Woosung Road to North Soochow Road and
return via North Szechuen Road.

The Japanese civilian population have been asked
to be at Hongkew Park by 9 a.m. and will line North
Szechuen Road Extension to watch the march.

以下部队将参加29日的阅兵式：

1个机枪团
1个榴弹炮连

上述部队将从江湾集结，并于上午8时30分在公立男校以北的江湾路沿线就位，接受白川少将的检阅。

3个步兵团经后门进入虹口公园

在虹口公园检阅后，3个步兵团将于上午11时左右出发。
2个团将跟随主力走同一路线。
1个团将沿同一路线行进至西华德路，然后前往狄思威路 - 百老汇路。海军装甲车将从吴淞路前往北苏州路，并经北四川路返回。

已要求日本平民于上午9时前到达虹口公园，并将沿北四川路延伸段列队观看游行。

pages.en:
General Shirakawa

Captain Dicker, on behalf of Brigadier Fleming,
asks for a Police Car to escort General Shirakawa
from Szechuen Road Bridge to the Japanese Consul-
General's residence, 15 Seymour Road. This car to be
manned by foreigners. The time is not quite certain,
but the General will not leave Hongkew Park before
11.30 a.m. on April 29. There will be four cars :
No. 1 General Shirakawa with a military policeman armed
with a revolver. No.2 Three men with carbine.
No. 3 Chief of Staff. No. 4 Army Adjutants .
The Police car should fall in at the rear of the
fourth car.

I suggest a motor cycle in addition to lead the
procession and arrangements to be made for an uninterrupted
passage so far as possible.

Route : Szechmen Road to Nanking Road to Seymour Road.

P.S. The four cars conveying the Japanese official
party will be preceded by a motor cycle and followed by
a motor car.

白川将军

迪克上尉代表弗莱明准将，请求派一辆警车护送白川将军从四川路桥前往位于西摩路15号的日本总领事官邸。该车需由外籍人员驾驶。时间尚不完全确定，但将军不会在4月29日上午11时30分之前离开虹口公园。将有四辆车：
1号车为白川将军，配有一名携带左轮手枪的宪兵。2号车为三名携带卡宾枪的人员。
3号车为参谋长。4号车为陆军副官。
警车应跟在第四辆车后面。

我建议额外增加一辆摩托车引领车队，并尽可能安排畅通无阻的通行。

路线：四川路至南京路至西摩路。

附言：运送日本官方代表团的四辆车将由一辆摩托车开道，后随一辆机动车。

JAPANESE CONSULATE GENERAL
25-A WHANGPOO ROAD, SHANGHAI
APRIL 28, 1932, (AFTERNOON)

COMMUNIQUE (1)

(1) An official reception to celebrate the birthday of His
Imperial Japanese Majesty will be held from 12:00 to 1:00 p.m.
at the official residence of the Japanese Consul-General, to which
function invitations have been issued.

------------------

The order of the Military Review in celebration of the birth-
day of His Imperial Japanese Majesty, weather permitting, will be
as follows:

(2) Military Review at the Hongkew Park,
9:30 to 10:30 a.m.
Air Parade 10:00 a.m.
(Note. Traffic is expected to be heavy. Those who
are invited to the Reserved Section are requested
to be at the corner, next to the Headquarters of
the Japanese Naval Landing Force, of Kiangwan and
North Szechuen Roads by 9:00 a.m.)

------------------

(3) Other ceremonies at the Hongkew Park on the same oc-
casion will be observed as follows:

Ceremony under the auspices of the Japanese
Community, 11:30 to 12:00 noon
Salute of 101 guns, 12:00 noon
Stunt flying, School-children's mass games and
Military Band beginning from 1:00 p.m.

GUN FIRE ON JAPANESE EMPEROR'S BIRTHDAY.

The Sin Wan Pao publishes the following item
on April 27, 1932:-

At 11.30 a.m. Friday (April 29) the Japanese
Army will celebrate the birthday anniversary of the
Japanese Emperor by firing 101 shots. This does not
mean a resumption of hostilities in Shanghai.
Residents should not be alarmed.

The Shun Pao and the Eastern Times publish
the following report on April 27:-

April 29 is the birthday anniversary of the
Japanese Emperor. 101 blank shots will be fired by
the Japanese army at the Rifle Range at 11 a.m. on
that day. The calibre of the gun used will be 7½ m.m.
The public should not be excited upon hearing the gunfire.

The China Times published the following report
on April 26:-

The Shanghai Municipal Council has issued
the following notice:-

The Japanese forces will celebrate the
birthday anniversary of their Emperor on April 29.
At 11.30 a.m. they will fire 101 blank shots at the
Rifle Range. This does not mean that hostilities
have been resumed. Residents should remain undisturbed.

日本天皇诞辰日的枪声。

《新闻报》于1932年4月27日刊登如下消息：-

4月29日（星期五）上午11时30分，日本
军队将通过鸣放101响礼炮来庆祝日本天皇的诞辰纪念日。这并不
意味着上海战事重启。
居民不必惊慌。

《申报》和《字林西报》于4月27日刊登
如下报道：-

4月29日是日本天皇的诞辰纪念日。当日
上午11时，日军将在射击场鸣放101响空包弹。所用枪支口径为7.5毫米。
公众听到枪声时切勿惊慌。

《时事新报》于4月26日刊登如下报道：-

上海公共租界工部局已发布如下通告：-

日本军队将于4月29日庆祝其天皇的诞辰纪念日。
上午11时30分，他们将在射击场鸣放101响空包弹。这并不
意味着战事重启。居民应保持镇定。

C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3566.
Date 26/4/32

April 25, 1932.

s. 5(6.D.I. Prince)

It is reported that the Japanese festivities
on April 29 will include the firing of one hundred
and one guns.

Please request the Chinese newspapers to
publish this information so that the population
will not be alarmed.

〔签名〕
Officer i/c Special Branch.

SI,
Information and
please pass W Reg
White.

S. D. Prince on 25/4/32
